ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 80% coverage) contrasted against a low-intensity black perimeter and median band (approx. 20% coverage).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black contiguous band along the entire trailing edge and tips. A vertical dark pixel bridge at the median notch. Scattered low-intensity clusters (mottling) distributed across both lobe interiors.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to the lobe peaks of approx. 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations across the trailing edge; peaks and valleys range from 2 to 8 pixel amplitudes relative to the local edge tangent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve along the trailing edge leading to narrow, pointed tips with a slight posterior recurve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters (diameters < 10 pixels) concentrated near the median notch and the peripheral black-to-white transition zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark linear pixel disruptions: one horizontal-curved mark on the far left lobe, and two near-vertical parallel lines on the right lobe interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense dark pixel cluster at the base of the median notch; irregular nicks in the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical distribution of the white pigmentation field relative to the central vertical axis.
